overview: No anticheat in the corpus runs a check on the sign-update packet. The only real server-side reference is Artemis, which registers PacketPlayServerUpdateSign at SERVER_PLAY + 82; the rest of the mined corpus is keyword noise from the search term Sign: client-side sign-editing handling (C12PacketUpdateSign in Grim ExploitB and Vrekt-Arc PayloadFrequency, MC|BSign payload checks in Truthful CrasherA and Grim, Intave ItemCrashTracker.checkSign on Client.UPDATE_SIGN), sign block physics and placement in NoCheatPlus AutoSign, Kauri Materials and ThotPatrol UtilBlock, and unrelated JVM method-signature code in Intave's bundled ASM library. Sign text is authoritative world data the client renders, so server-side anticheats have nothing to measure.
